header: Three steps from first edit to live site
subheadline: Edit inline in the Visual Editor, publish in a light theme, then switch to dark mode without writing CSS. One package does all three.

slides.title: Edit the page you see
slides.lead: In the Visual Editor, you edit the site itself: click, type, publish.
slides.description: Editors work on the rendered page with the live theme. What they see is what visitors get.

image.title: Editing in the Visual Editor
image.alternative: The TYPO3 Visual Editor with a Desiderio page open for inline editing.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

slides.title: Publish a consistent design
slides.lead: The published site follows one design system.
slides.description: All 244 elements use the same colour tokens, so headlines, cards and buttons match. This is the Lagoon preset, unchanged.

image.title: Desiderio frontend in the Lagoon preset
image.alternative: A Desiderio hero page in the light Lagoon theme preset.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

slides.title: Dark mode included
slides.lead: Light and dark mode share one set of tokens. Switch, and every element follows.
slides.description: There is no second stylesheet. The Midnight preset shows this pricing page with WCAG 2.2-checked contrast.
